is_fee_on_transfer_token.meaning: the deposited token deducts a percentage fee on each transfer

deposit_amount.meaning: amount parameter passed to increaseTokenBalance() by the depositing user

received_amount.meaning: tokens actually received by the contract after the fee-on-transfer deduction

credited_balance.meaning: user balance recorded by _updateBalance for the deposit

withdrawable_amount.meaning: amount a later withdrawer can actually withdraw from the contract

full_balance_owed.meaning: full recorded balance a later withdrawer is owed

assumptions: The depositing user is an ordinary caller of increaseTokenBalance(); the report does not state any authorization requirement.
The contract holds no other tokens that could cover the fee-on-transfer shortfall.
The 1% fee-on-transfer rate applies uniformly to the deposit transfer.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether increaseTokenBalance() is permissionless or restricted, so the caller scope of the deposit scenario is not fixed.
Report gives the last ~1% of withdrawers as the affected group but no exact count or ordering of withdrawers, so the victim set is only qualitatively bounded.

limitations: The conservation relation is stated at the amount level: credited balance should equal tokens actually received, and later withdrawers should be able to withdraw their full recorded balance.
The ~1% figure for affected withdrawers is retained only as a qualitative scope note; no exact victim count is formalized.
Higher-fee token scaling (5-10%) mentioned in ambiguities is not part of this claim.
